data_description.host: The hostname or IP address of your sprinkler controller.

user.description: Please enter the host name or IP address of your IntelliDwell Sprinkler Controller.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect, please check your network connection and try again.

init.title: Weather Push & Automatic Rain Delay
init.description: Select the Home Assistant weather/rain entities to push directly to the sprinkler controller over LAN and configure automatic rain-delay thresholds.

data.stop_active_watering: Stop Active Watering Immediately on Rain

data_description.weather_push_enabled: When enabled, selected weather and rainfall readings are pushed automatically to the controller.
data_description.rain_sensor: Sensor reporting today's accumulated rainfall in inches (e.g., Ambient Weather daily rain sensor).
data_description.temp_sensor: Optional outdoor temperature sensor to push live temperature to the controller.
data_description.weather_entity: Optional weather.* entity used for precipitation forecast probability (and temperature fallback if no sensor is chosen).
data_description.source_name: Label displayed on the controller weather badge and Cloud UI. Leave blank to use the selected sensor's friendly name.
data_description.auto_rain_delay: Automatically set a rain delay on the controller when rainfall or forecast probability exceeds your thresholds.
data_description.rain_threshold: Minimum daily rainfall (inches) to trigger a standard rain delay.
data_description.delay_days: Number of days to suspend watering when the standard rain threshold is reached.
data_description.heavy_rain_threshold: Minimum daily rainfall (inches) to trigger an extended rain delay.
data_description.heavy_delay_days: Number of days to suspend watering when the heavy rain threshold is reached.
data_description.forecast_pop_threshold: Minimum today precipitation probability (%) from the selected weather entity to apply a 1-day pre-emptive delay.
data_description.stop_active_watering: Cancel active zone timers immediately if today's rainfall reaches or exceeds the standard rain threshold.
